propositions: test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer runs a monolithic loop over 884 corpus units with ~1768 total pandoc spawns, taking 91.6s idle but 504.8s under CPU saturation (1.7x over the 300s CI budget)

pytest-timeout with --timeout-method=thread calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the xdist worker without traceback when per-test cost exceeds budget, manifesting as worker crash on macOS py3.13 cell

the 14-minute gap between 'node down: Not properly terminated' and 'worker crashed' log lines is a reporting artifact (xdist logs death immediately, pytest prints failure reports at session end), not evidence of hang latency

fixing requires chunk-parametrizing the test with fixed-size batches (_EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40) so per-test cost becomes bounded independent of corpus growth, and adding a coverage guard test to ensure all 884 units remain compared
